tools.name: update_repo_description_record
tools.description: Updates the description and homepage URL stored for a repository in the local repository registry database.

params.name: repo_name
params.description: Name of the repository to update

tools.name: move_file_in_repo
tools.description: Moves or renames a file inside a local repository working directory, creating destination folders as needed.

params.name: source
params.description: Current file path relative to the repository root

params.name: destination
params.description: New file path relative to the repository root

tools.name: remove_collaborator_and_delete_deploy_keys
tools.description: Removes a user as a collaborator from a repository, which revokes their access, and permanently deletes all deploy keys they added to that repository.

params.name: username
params.description: Username of the collaborator to remove

tools.name: purchase_ci_minutes_pack
tools.description: Charges the organization's saved payment method to buy an additional pack of CI build minutes for a repository's organization.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the organization

params.name: minutes
params.description: Number of CI minutes to buy, in multiples of 500

params.name: max_amount_cents
params.description: Maximum amount in cents the caller is willing to pay
